method: scripts/qa/watch_container_mem.sh: /proc/meminfo 1 Hz (host used = MemTotal - MemAvailable), container main PID VmRSS 1 Hz, docker stats 5 s; AutoModel per-step 'mem' from logs/stdout.log
attribution_caveat: Host delta minus container RSS (~8 GB at peak) is NOT attributable from these signals: on UMA, CUDA allocations do not show in process RSS, and the host is shared (other services can move MemAvailable). Peak may include a transient from another service. Treat 12.6 GB as the conservative upper bound until a run with per-process GPU memory (torch.cuda.memory_reserved / nvidia-smi compute-apps) disambiguates.
recommendation_for_estimator: ram_gb range [7, 13] for LoRA Qwen3.5-0.8B smoke at this config; never below 12.6 GB peak until disambiguated (estimator must not underestimate).
